review_candidates.description: ←Back to all jobs at Northumberland Ferries Limited IT Operations Manager Halifax, NS Full-time $85000.00-$95000.00/year IT Operations Manager Locations: Halifax, NS | Charlottetown, PE | Caribou, NS Job Type: Full-time Salary: $85,000–$95,000 per year Industry: Transportation Department: Information Technology & Data Management Reports to: Director, IT & Data Management Build the Foundation for Reliable IT Operations Northumberland Ferries Limited and Bay Ferries Limited are seeking an experienced IT Operations Manager to lead the day-to-day delivery, security, and reliability of IT services across our offices, terminals, and vessels throughout the Maritimes. This is a hands-on IT leadership role for someone who can lead people, projects, and service providers while remaining technically engaged in the systems that keep a complex, multi-site operation running. You'll oversee the service desk, field support, end-user technology, networks and connectivity, Microsoft 365 administration, cybersecurity operations, IT assets, infrastructure projects, and operational technology vendors. You'll also play an important role in modernizing IT operations, improving service levels, strengthening documentation, and ensuring technology supports the safety and operational needs of our fleet. What You'll Do Lead IT Service Delivery Lead day-to-day IT service delivery across vessels, terminals, and offices, including the service desk, field services, operational technology, and technical escalations. Direct the daily work of IT operations personnel, contractors, and service providers. Maintain an effective on-call framework for 24/7 critical support. Prioritize incidents, maintenance, and changes based on operational, safety, and customer-service impacts. Establish and manage clear KPIs and service levels and regularly report on operational performance. Own the IT service desk and supporting ITSM platform as the primary system of record for incidents, requests, changes, and IT assets. Lead hardware, software, licensing, and telecommunications asset management throughout their lifecycle. Standardize IT onboarding, offboarding, and role-change processes in partnership with People & Culture. Maintain practical and effective IT documentation, including diagrams, procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base content. Identify opportunities to use AI securely and effectively to improve IT service delivery, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency. Manage Infrastructure & Microsoft 365 Lead the operational administration of Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, licensing, Conditional Access, MFA, groups, and permissions. Oversee networks, wireless infrastructure, remote access, VPNs, and ship-to-shore connectivity across vessels, terminals, and offices. Establish disciplined patching, monitoring, and technology lifecycle practices. Develop and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, including regular recovery testing. Oversee physical security technologies, including CCTV and access control systems. Strengthen Cybersecurity Operations Oversee cybersecurity for IT infrastructure and vessel operational technology, including appropriate IT/OT network segmentation. Manage operational security controls and tooling, including EDR, SIEM, and MDR services. Ensure security alerts and incidents are appropriately triaged, escalated, investigated, and remediated. Support cybersecurity risk management, assessments, penetration testing, exercises, employee awareness, metrics, remediation, and compliance activities. Help strengthen cybersecurity practices in alignment with recognized frameworks and operational requirements. Deliver Projects & Manage Vendors Develop an IT operations schedule aligned with vessel operating seasons, maintenance periods, dry docks, and refits. Plan and manage IT projects from initiation through implementation, including migrations, upgrades, and dry-dock work. Take accountability for project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and reporting. Develop and manage the IT operations budget and procurement of hardware, software, telecommunications, and support services. Manage MSPs, telecommunications companies, and technology vendors, ensuring accountability for service levels, support quality, and knowledge transfer. Partner with the Data Solutions Manager on data governance, information retention, and secure collaboration. What You'll Bring A degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Systems, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. At least five years of progressive experience in IT operations, infrastructure, or systems administration. Experience building, improving, or modernizing IT operations in a growing or evolving environment. Strong hands-on Microsoft 365 administration experience, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune. Strong technical knowledge of endpoints, networking, wireless infrastructure, servers, cloud services, and telecommunications. Experience with network management platforms such as UniFi, Cisco Meraki, or similar technologies. Practical IT service management experience, including service desk platforms. ITIL knowledge is strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to successfully deliver IT projects on time and within budget. Project management training is an asset. Experience establishing and managing KPIs and service levels and holding technology vendors accountable for agreed outcomes. Working knowledge of cybersecurity operations, backup and disaster recovery, and incident response. Familiarity with NIST or CIS Controls is an asset. Experience using AI tools to improve IT operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. An understanding of confidentiality, privacy, audit, and information governance requirements. Strong communication, organization, troubleshooting, and leadership skills. A commitment to a strong safety culture grounded in just-culture principles and to working within and contributing to the company's management system. Experience supporting a multi-site, 24/7, transportation, maritime, or similarly operational environment is a strong asset. Working in This Role This isn't a management role that operates only from behind a desk. You'll work in a normal office environment while also routinely visiting vessels, terminals, dock facilities, and other operational locations throughout the Maritimes. The position involves significant road travel and occasional overnight travel. You'll Need To Hold a valid driver's licence and passport. Be willing to travel throughout the Maritimes. Be available for occasional evening, weekend, and after-hours support when operations require it, including incidents, outages, maintenance, and recovery activities. Be comfortable accessing technology throughout vessels and terminals, including climbing ladders and working in equipment spaces. Why Join Us? Technology is integral to the safe and reliable operation of our vessels, terminals, and passenger services. This position provides an opportunity to take ownership of IT operations in an environment where technology has a direct and visible impact on day-to-day operations. You'll have the opportunity to build and improve the IT operating model, modernize processes and tools, strengthen cybersecurity and resilience, lead infrastructure projects, and develop a disciplined service culture while still remaining connected to the technology. If you're an experienced IT professional who enjoys building better systems, solving complex problems, leading a lean team, and staying hands-on, we'd like to hear from you. Salary: $85,000–$95,000 per year Employment: Full-time Locations: Halifax, NS | Charlottetown, PE | Caribou, NS Please visit our careers page to see more job opportunities.
